# BASED NUT

> BASED NUT is an experimental memefi project on Base (Coinbase L2) featuring a unity token (NUT, supply=1), deflationary reward-position (SNUT, 6% tax buyback/burn), Balancer index basket (pNUT, 25% cbETH/cbBTC/NUT/SNUT), and Mint Club bonding-curve tokens (SALT, NUTINO). NOT financial advice. Trade at your own risk.

Key information:

- This is a Next.js frontend for the BASED NUT DeFi ecosystem on Base mainnet (chainId 8453)
- All token pages display real-time on-chain data fetched from Base RPC, GeckoTerminal, DexScreener, CoinGecko, and Balancer API
- Contract addresses are listed on each token page and the arb-bot machine spec
- The SNUT page features live burn tracking, tax flow diagrams, and recursive deflationary mechanics
- The arb-bot page documents 9 arbitrage loops with execution strategies and a machine-readable JSON spec
- NUT has supply=1 (unity token) — TRUE Price = TRUE Market Cap. Standard APIs often miscalculate.
- SNUT is a non-escrow reward-position: hold SNUT to automatically earn NUT rewards, no locking required
- pNUT NAV = totalLiquidity / totalShares (Balancer V2 weighted pool)
- Mint Club tokens use bonding curves: price = NUT_locked / token_supply, 1% royalty on mint/burn
- This is an EXPERIMENTAL MEMEFI project — NOT financial advice, NOT an investment

## Core Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with ecosystem overview, token cards, and live market data
- [All Tokens](/tokens): Overview of all tokens in the ecosystem with filters
- [Token Tree](/tree): Visual hierarchy showing token relationships and derivation
- [Staking](/staking): Active reward-position pools, vaults, and TVL
- [Arb Bot War Room](/arb-bot): 9 arbitrage loops, machine-readable spec, execution doctrine, risk disclaimer
- [FAQ](/faq): 42 questions in 6 categories (Basics, Tokens, Arbitrage, Liquidity, NFTs, Risks)
- [Chat](/chat): Community chat with Peanutoshi AI assistant
- [Images](/images): Media gallery and asset collection

## Token Pages

- [NUT](/token/nut): Unity token — supply=1, no tax, anchor asset for all nested tokens
- [SNUT](/token/snut): Deflationary reward-position — 6% tax, live burn tracker, recursive burn flywheel
- [pNUT](/token/pnut): Balancer V2 index basket — 25% each cbETH/cbBTC/NUT/SNUT, inflationary counterbalance
- [SALT](/token/salt): Mint Club bonding-curve token — arbitrage via Aerodrome SALT/USDC
- [NUTINO](/token/nutino): Mint Club bonding-curve token — arbitrage via Uniswap V2 NUTINO/cbBTC
- [pNUTS](/token/pnuts): Peanut War Generals NFT — 251 supply, linear bonding curve
- [ALMD](/token/almd): Almond War Generals NFT — 424 supply, exponential bonding curve
- [sALMD](/token/salmd): Almond Soldiers NFT — 6,238 supply
- [PNUTRMY](/token/pnutrmy): Peanut Soldiers NFT — 5,013 supply
